subject: Request to revive expired trial + one-time credit reinstatement
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@neptunelabs.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neptune Labs Procurement <procurement@neptunelabs.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Trial expired — request to revive sandbox and credits

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. We were running a short proof-of-concept with Redwood in June but the trial expired while we were tied up in procurement. The sandbox still has a lot of useful eval results and the team would like to finish the ETL + LLM tuning exercise.

Can Redwood reopen the sandbox and reinstate some of the expired trial credits so we can complete a final run? We’re not asking for an open-ended grant — just enough tokens to complete the evaluation (estimate attached).

Attached: usage_snapshot_aug10.csv (small CSV showing usage pattern)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

—Julia
Julia Park
Head of ML, Neptune Labs
julia@neptunelabs.ai
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@neptunelabs.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial expired — request to revive sandbox and credits

Hi Julia — thanks for the note and upload.

Appreciate the clarity on scope. I reviewed the snapshot and it looks like you ran several longer sequences which consumed most of the promo allocation. We can do a one-time reactivation for evaluation completion, but I need sign-off from Sales Ops and a quick acknowledgement of the intended completion window (so we can close the loop on billing controls).

Proposed path:
- One-time credit reinstatement: 20,000 tokens (valid for 14 days after reactivation)
- Sandbox access reinstated to the same project and region (us-west)
- We’ll provide a short list of batching/kv-cache recommendations to keep token spend efficient

If that works, I’ll coordinate the offer document and loop in Marissa for final authorization.

Can you confirm acceptance of the 14-day window and that Neptune will complete the final eval by Aug 28?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0120
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Trial expired — request to revive sandbox and credits

Tessa / Marissa — I reviewed Neptune’s usage and Julias’s ask. Sales Ops is okay with a one-time, conditional reinstatement; we should include a short acceptance doc and a soft quota to prevent runaway spend.

My suggested terms (for the offer PDF):
- 20,000 free tokens, single-use, expires 14 days after reactivation
- Sandbox reinstated to the existing project; model pinned to rwd-medium to align performance/cost
- If Neptune requests >20k tokens we’ll route them to a trial-topup discussion with the Sales team (no automatic top-up)
- Customer signs a brief acknowledgement (DocuSign) confirming completion window and acceptance of the trial reactivation terms

Marissa — can you sign off if Sales Leadership is good with this? If yes I’ll attach the PDF and the DocuSign link and Tessa can send it over.

—Ben
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Julia Park <julia@neptunelabs.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial expired — request to revive sandbox and credits

Thanks all — approved.

Julia — we’re happy to offer the one-time reactivation on the terms Ben outlined. I’ve attached the offer PDF and a DocuSign link below; once we receive the signed acknowledgement we’ll reactivate the sandbox and credit the 20k tokens. Please review and sign by EOD Aug 18 so we can get you back up and running.

Attachments: redwood_one_time_credit_offer.pdf, signed_msa_docusign_link.txt
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/signed/abc123

Looking forward to seeing your team’s final results — shout if you need help with batching suggestions or a short sync to walk through caching knobs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
